summary: Newspaper editor of the Sunday Independent who died at Alexandria, Virginia, in 1958; John's 2nd-great-grand-uncle.
bio:
John Vincent Heffernan was born on 9 July 1886 and became a newspaperman, serving as associate editor of the Sunday Independent. On 4 May 1914 he married Edith Corrine Grammes, whose surname is also given as Graham, in Manhattan, New York City. Edith (1896–1938) was a daughter of Cyrus Randolph Grammes and Martha L. Robinson; she died at Wilkes-Barre on 6 November 1938 and was buried at Fairview Cemetery, Danville. Their daughter was Mary Louise Heffernan (1921–2011).

He was living at Kingston, Pa., in 1930 and was still there when he registered for the Second World War draft in 1942. He died at Alexandria, Virginia, on 1 March 1958. He is John's 2nd-great-grand-uncle.
